params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal scene, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows). A paper wall calendar with all cells blank hanging on a dark wall, a corner curling — next time. Single warm key light, deep coffee-brown shadows, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze, subtle golden dust. The object sits in the lower third of the frame; the upper 60% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography. No people, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark. Premium, calm mood.
